source: 16 station scan screenshots sent by the user on 2026-11-14 (Kiosk 'Enlarged scan image' dialogs, CAM-001..004, Lakatan, Latundan and Cardaba hands), scanned with commit e734431. The photos are not stored in the repository.
method: Boxes were found from their overlay strokes and label tags; the 18 % overlay fill of every covering box was removed (a first pass that removed only each box's own fill left neighbours' fills on, which brightened shadows; the independent review caught it); each box's central region (20 % trimmed per side) was converted to OpenCV HSV. 'non_banana' is the share of pixels that are dark (value < 40) or bluish/violet (hue 100-165, saturation >= 25).
units: OpenCV HSV: hue 0-179, saturation and value 0-255

non_finger_boxes.label: Lakatan Unripe 76%
non_finger_boxes.note: own fill removed only (its bottom edge is cut by the frame, so the full removal could not trace it)

finger_examples.what: shaded underside of the hand (low-confidence second-pass box)

finger_boxes_non_banana.note: Only boxes whose four edges were traced cleanly. One more finger-labelled box scored 0.73: 'Cardaba Unripe 79%' at the left edge of screenshot 16, which is mostly the dark curtain plus the tip of a finger another box already counts; dropping it is intended. With value < 60 as the dark cut, a shaded second-pass box in screenshot 9 scored 0.78 and would have been dropped; with value < 40 it scores 0.19.

threshold.why: Above every cleanly measured finger box (0.32) and below every crown/curtain box (0.72-0.86).

limits: Measured on rendered screenshots, not raw camera frames, on one station's cameras and lighting. A crown cut that looks brown rather than bluish-grey, or a different background, is not covered; retrain with station photos for that.
